ConnectionStrings.//: The slim dev stack (infra/docker-compose.dev.slim.yml) publishes both on loopback.

Postgres.//: The slim stack has no PgBouncer, so prepared statements and DISCARD ALL are fine.

//: No SigningKeyPem: SigningKeyRing mints an ephemeral RS256 key and warns. Tokens die with
the process and a second replica would publish a different JWKS — Development only.
The same value infra/env/.env.common.example gives EMQX's EMQX_AUTHENTICATION__1__SECRET.
It has to match exactly or the broker refuses every CONNECT — and it is a development
secret in a file precisely because it is not one: anything holding it can mint a token for
any vehicle, which is why D6' §3.2 replaces the whole scheme with RS256 in C030.

Auth.//: PBKDF2 at production cost makes every local sign-in a visible pause; the lock-out is unchanged.
